title: A bundle chart and a failed bundle
promptMarkdown: Construct a local trivialization of $\mathrm{St}_2(\mathbb R^4)\to\mathrm{Gr}_2(\mathbb R^4)$ using graph charts and identify the fibre and all three dimensions. Then prove that the punctured-plane projection in the lesson is a surjective submersion but is not a fibre bundle.
hintLadder: Project a frame to the fixed plane.
A choice of basis of one fixed plane is an invertible 2×2 matrix.
